translations.web: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
translations.bsb: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
translations.kjv: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
translations.asv: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him; and he shall go forth with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
